items.textToSpeech: For children under 18, the Adequate Intakes for magnesium increase with age and range from 80 milligrams per day for those aged 7-11 months, up to 300 milligrams of magnesium per day for males aged 10-17, and up to 250 milligrams of magnesium per day for females aged 10-17. See the associated table or the source document for full details.
The Adequate Intake is the average observed or experimentally determined approximations or estimates of nutrient intake that is assumed to be adequate. Is there anything else I can help you with?
